mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to how developed and complex a character is in literary work."

Oxymoron is a statement which, on the surface, seems to contradict itself - a kind of crisp contradiction.

Emotional appeals are considered fallacies, or errors in reasoning, because they manipulate emotions in an audience.

Poetry is the oldest form of literature and probably predates writing itself.

Creative writing is an art and has very little to do with (the) information dissemination even though it does communicate some information.

Imaginative means having or showing an ability to think of new and interesting ideas: having or showing imagination.

Emotion is one of the three modes of persuasion identified by Aristotle.

Figures of speech are used in "figurative language" to add color and interest, and to awaken the imagination.

Mood is the feeling that the author tries to convey throughout the story; or the atmosphere or emotional condition created by the story piece, within the setting.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a word or phrase used in comparing two opposite objects, ideas, thoughts or feelings to provide a clearer description."
A metaphor is a word or phrase used in comparing two opposite objects, ideas, thoughts or feelings to provide a clearer description.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the art of persuasion through emotion, but using elements of logic or reason."
Rhetoric is the art of persuasion through emotion, but using elements of logic or reason.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the sequence of events that make up a story."
Plot is the sequence of events that make up a story.
